chunking.description: Candidate texts built as symbol plus sorted token set, exactly as Memory.answer constructs them.

preprocessing.description: Raw text as constructed; no normalization, truncation, or stopword removal.

limitations: 20 dev tasks, 1-hop impact phrasing; retrieval only, no model loop.
Server-side embedding time and RAM not instrumented.
Set scores recomputed deterministically from the committed ranked lists (selection code unchanged since that run); no model calls in this step.
protocol: dev-only retrieval scoring; tune freely; held-out stays untouched. Set metrics (P/R/F1/exact) score the answer set after the gold-free query-leaf exclusion (caller_ranked rule: the named subject is context, never an impact answer); ranking metrics use the raw list.
